full_prompt_en: A square Pre-Raphaelite-inspired oil portrait shows a young woman in left-facing profile, her eyes closed amid a dense nestlike halo of golden straw. The head and shoulders occupy most of the center, while long copper-red hair spreads outward and blends with the surrounding dry fibers. Her pale face is lit softly, with a fine nose, closed eyelid, and small red mouth set against deep warm brown. She wears a dark forest-green outer garment over a richly patterned rust-orange bodice. The bodice's small woven marks and the outer fabric's broad folds make a clear contrast between ornament and shadow. Around her head, hundreds of strawlike lines curve, twist, and cross, filling the upper left and right corners with a nearly continuous golden texture. The lines become darkest near the outer edges, allowing the face and upper chest to remain the quiet central opening. A few loose curls fall across her shoulder and merge with the fibrous background. The image offers no distinct room, landscape, or narrative action; the woman seems held within the material around her. Warm side light enters from the upper left, lifting her cheek, hair, and selected straw strands while the garment and deeper nest fall into brown-black shade. Brushwork is delicate and blended on the face, more linear and tactile in the surrounding fibers. The overall composition balances a still pale profile against a turbulent circular field of copper and gold, creating a hushed, dreamlike intensity.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形拉斐尔前派气息的油画肖像呈现一位年轻女子朝左侧身，双眼闭合，周围是密密的金色干草巢状光环。头肩占据中央大部，长铜红发向外铺开，与周围干纤维相融。浅色面孔受柔光照亮，细鼻、闭合眼睑和小红唇置于深暖棕前。她穿深林绿外衣，里面是纹样丰富的锈橙色上衣。上衣的细小编织线迹与外衣宽阔褶影形成装饰与阴影的清楚对照。头周围数百根似干草的线弯曲、扭转、交叉，以近乎连续的金色纹理填满左上和右上两角。线迹向外围加深，让面孔与上胸保持安静中央开口。几缕卷发落过肩膀并融进纤维背景。画中没有明确房间、风景或叙事动作；女子像被周围材料托住。暖侧光从左上进入，挑亮脸颊、头发和选定干草线，衣服与更深巢层则落入棕黑影。脸部笔触细腻融合，周围纤维更线性、更可触。整体构图以静止浅色侧影平衡湍动的铜金色圆形色域，形成安静梦境般的强度。
style_prompt_en: The oil painting combines delicately blended central light with an enveloping field of fine, energetic lines. Copper, ochre, burnt gold, deep green, and brown-black interweave, leaving one pale focal opening. Warm side illumination selects smooth planes and individual fibers while the outer field deepens into rich shadow. Surface treatment shifts from velvety tonal modeling to sharp, dry, wiry strokes. The surrounding linear rhythm curls toward the still center, creating a dense but intimate composition. The effect is romantic, tactile, and quietly strange.
style_prompt_zh: 这种油画把中央细腻融合的亮面与围合的细密活跃线域结合起来。铜色、赭黄、焦金、深绿与棕黑交织，只留下一个浅色焦点开口。暖侧光选择光滑平面与单根纤维，外围色域逐渐加深为浓厚阴影。表面处理从丝绒般调子塑造转到锐利、干燥、细硬笔形。周围线性节奏朝静止中心卷曲，形成密集却亲近的构图。效果浪漫、可触而安静奇异。
theme_en: A closed-eyed red-haired woman within a golden nestlike halo
theme_zh: 闭眼红发女子处在金色巢状光环中
name: Edward Robert Hughes
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
